title: Time
theory:
> **Curriculum:** This chapter follows [LEARN-LANGUAGES/CURRICULUM.md](../../CURRICULUM.md).

## Time in C#

Prefer **`DateTimeOffset`** for instants with offsets, **`TimeSpan`** for durations, and **`TimeZoneInfo`** for named zones. Use **`CultureInfo.InvariantCulture`** when parsing and formatting must be stable across machines.

exercises.title: Build a UTC instant
exercises.description: Create **2024-01-01 12:00:00 UTC** and print it exactly in the checker’s format.
hints: Append the literal ` UTC` to match the Rust/Go exercises

exercises.title: Components in Tokyo
exercises.description: Build **2023-03-15 14:30** in **`Asia/Tokyo`** and print the component lines expected by the checker.
exercises.expected_output:
Year: 2023
Month: March
Day: 15
Hour: 14
Minute: 30
Weekday: Wednesday
hints: `TimeZoneInfo.ConvertTimeFromUtc` helps when you start from a UTC instant

exercises.title: Durations
exercises.description: Print a Go-style duration line for **2h30m0s**, then print **`500ms`** on the next line.
hints: `TotalHours` is a `double`—cast to `int` for the hours field in this exercise

exercises.title: Parse naive datetime
exercises.description: Parse `"2024-06-15 09:30:00"` as UTC wall time and print `yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss UTC`.
hints: `DateTimeStyles.AssumeUniversal | DateTimeStyles.AdjustToUniversal` treats the value as UTC

exercises.title: Format
hints: `%e`-style single-digit days are awkward—format with `d` and post-process double spaces if needed

exercises.title: Add duration
exercises.description: Start at **2024-01-15 10:00 UTC**, add **3 days + 5 hours**, print the result in the same style as other UTC exercises.

exercises.title: Subtract instants
exercises.description: Between **2024-11-25** and **2024-12-25** UTC midnights, print `720h0m0s` then `Days: 30`.

exercises.title: Before / after
exercises.description: Compare two UTC instants and print the two boolean lines expected by the checker.
exercises.expected_output:
January 1 is before December 31: true
December 31 is after January 1: true

exercises.title: Fixed clock (no wall time)
exercises.description: Use a fixed `DateTimeOffset` (no `DateTime.Now`) and print the instant, hour/minute, then **+1s** labeled like the checker.
hints: Keep everything in UTC for stable output
